label: sdc01_0280_student1_02
text: Carmine wanted me to tell you that she’s waiting\nat her place. She said, “You’d better get a move\r\non—and don’t keep me waiting!”

label: sdc01_0280_student1_03
text: I’m her partner, and yet you’re the one who gets\ninvited to her house... What exactly is going on\r\nwith you two, anyway?

label: sdc01_0280_student2_01
text: The caretaker showed us some really cool masks\nyesterday!

label: sdc01_0280_student3_01
text:

Wow, that was fast!\c

she’s making sure I don’t overexert myself.
